title: Karl Mayer plans to sell the Stoll brand | textile network
content: # Karl Mayer plans to sell the Stoll brand. In order to secure its competitiveness in the global market, the family-owned company Karl Mayer is realigning itself and will once again focus on its core business areas in the future. With the strategic reorientation, the company will continue to rely on its tradition and innovative strength in order to meet the challenges of the global market. In future, the long-established family company will be focusing once again on its core business areas – warp knitting, warp preparation and technical textiles. Karl Mayer is investing in the further development of its machine technologies in its core areas – a measure that takes account of the needs of its customers. As part of the strategic reorientation, the company has also decided to divest the flat knitting machine business under the Stoll brand in 2025.
